A crock is great but you can make great sauerkraut in a mason jar.

Cut up the cabbage into slices or shreds and start putting it in the bottom of the jar. Use a pestle or heck a quality piece of wooden dowel (Closet rod) about 1" in diameter. Press the cabbage into the jar in !" lifts/layers. Don't press on jar so hard you break it. Sprinkle a little quality sea salt / Real Salt onto each layer. I think an entire jar gets a teaspoon or two of salt. Juice will come out of cabbage. Add some caraway seeds along the way if you want. Continue until the cabbage that is now covered in cabbage water is about 1 1/2" from the top of the jar. Top off with a leaf of cabbage to kind of keep the top of the cabbage moist. If you have liquid whey add a teaspoon of that. Place lid LOOSELY on top of jar. Place it inside an overflow bowl or pan on counter-top out of sunlight for about 3 days. You've got Kraut! Refrigerate. If you start adding other stuff like the ton of garlic you plan to make you'll have KimChi; but that stuff smells so bad you won't be allowed to keep it in the refrigerator.
